race.description: Hyoketsu Summer Series On Sale Mdn
race.comment: BLINDFOLDED (10) sets the standard after a sound debut fourth at Northam, where he was a well-supported favourite and beaten just under two lengths in a Mdn. With William Pike booked and the best recent exposed form in the race, he looks the runner with most upside. OFF THE RICHTER (11) was only beaten three and a half lengths at Ascot despite being tightened early and held up, and the move from metro to easier company gives him a genuine winning case with the rise in trip looking to suit. ZALI'S GIFT (6) has to be forgiven for a distant last at Northam after racing wide throughout, but her broader profile rates well and a recent Lark Hill trial win keeps her in the mix. LUCIFER'S LADY (7) resumes out of the Listed Belmont Oaks, has had two trials, and her earlier second at this track gives her claims if she returns in order. MAGNIFICENT BEAU (12) can make an impression on debut with a nice 1400m trial under her belt recently.
